description.content: Creates a subscription or scheduled payment to run at a specified time and frequency. You can use stored payment method tokens for card, ACH, and digital wallets by passing them into the `paymentMethod.storedMethodId` field.

query.description: When `true`, the request creates a new customer record, regardless of whether customer identifiers match an existing customer. Defaults to `false`.
